title: awesome-readme configuration
description: Per-repository rubric settings for readme-lint. Place at the repository root as .awesome-readme.json.

profile.description: Which set of sections a reader of this kind of project expects.

strict.description: Turn the advisory commit check into a blocking gate.

min_score.description: Score below which the linter exits non-zero. 0 disables the floor.

require.description: Sections this repository requires on top of its profile's set.

allow_badges.description: Substrings of badge URLs exempted from the vanity-badge rule.

check_links.description: Resolve relative links against the working tree.

session_summary.description: Report the README score once at the start of a Claude Code session.
